name: Sports extremes maker
description: Post-only bids on heavy favourites (bid >= 90c) and offers on longshots (ask <= 10c) in NBA and NHL game-winner markets, from 6 h before the estimated start through the game (cancelled at settlement). At the extremes the maker fee is ~0.14c against a 0.5c half-spread, and quotes are pulled when the mid moves 2c in 5 min (comebacks).
hypothesis: Takers who buy cheap longshots / sell near-certain favourites pay the 1c tick, which is 5-10% of the price there; the maker fee at the extremes is only 0.14c, so unlike mid-price quoting (pregame-maker: markout 0.25c < fee 0.44c) the spread is not eaten by the fee. Adverse selection comes from comebacks; the price-momentum pull is the protection. Wrong if the walk-forward pooled CI (net of maker fee) is <= 0, or the lockbox loses. Prior check: pooled Jan-May ad-hoc engine runs +1.5c/contract net of the exact maker fee.
